name: @intellectual-frontiers/anyfs-onedrive
description: The OneDrive backend of AnyFS: a store over a drive and a folder of Microsoft Graph, with a revision on every read and a stated expectation on every write, held to the same conformance suite as every backend.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
